activity.notes: Ernest Augustus I succeeded to the throne of Hanover on 20 June 1837 after the death of William IV. Victoria succeeded in the United Kingdom, while Hanover's succession rules excluded her, ending the personal union of the British and Hanoverian crowns. Ernest Augustus remained King of Hanover until his death on 18 November 1851. ATLAS therefore models this Activity specifically under the Kingdom of Hanover rather than under the United Kingdom.

sources.title: Ernest Augustus I, King of Hanover (1771-1851)
sources.citation_text: The University of Nottingham identifies Ernest Augustus I as King of Hanover and states that he inherited the Hanoverian throne in 1837 on the death of William IV.

sources.title: Historic Royal Speeches and Writings: Victoria
sources.citation_text: Queen Victoria's accession record dates William IV's death and the succession on 20 June 1837 and notes that the Duke of Cumberland simultaneously succeeded William IV as King of Hanover.
